tasks.title: Normalize WO toolbar icon rendering (24px, centered, consistent — keep WO icon designs)
tasks.acceptance_prose:
CONTEXT: the WO toolbar's ribbon icons are WO-authored inline SVGs (stroke-based, viewBox ~ 0 0 16 16) in apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg/index.html, currently rendered at inconsistent sizes (8-19px: width="15"", "14"", "16"", "17"") with mixed stroke-widths (1.4 / 1.5 / 1.8). style.css line ~601 has only `.toolbar button svg { display: block; margin: 0 auto; }` - horizontal centering only, no vertical centering, no uniform size, inside the now-46px-tall toolbar buttons.

IMPORTANT - ICON IDENTITY: the icons stay WO-designed. Do NOT replace any WO SVG with OnlyOffice/assets. OnlyOffice is OUT OF SCOPE except as the pixel-gate judge after merge. This task is WO-internal polish: every icon should render the same size, centered, crisp, consistent weight - a coherent WO icon set, NOT a clone of anyone's assets.

GOAL:
1. style.css `.toolbar button svg`: uniform width and height of 24px (accept 22-24px), display: block, both horizontally AND vertically centered within the 46px button (e.g. make the button display:flex align-items:center justify-content:center, or absolute positioning with top:50%; left:50%; transform:translate(-50%,-50%)). The rule must NOT affect non-toolbar svgs (there is an embedded 640x400 image - keep it out).
2. index.html: strip redundant per-icon width/height attributes on the toolbar button svgs (or set them to "24") so the single CSS rule governs; KEEP every viewBox, every path/d path, fill/stroke settings as-is. Do not redraw icons.
3. Consistency: for the viewBox 0 0 16 16 toolbar icons, unify stroke-width to a single value (recommend 1.75) so all icons share the same weight. Small helper glyphs (caret 10x6, checkbox 8x8, and the like inside menus/pickers) are NOT toolbar buttons - leave them alone.
4. Keep toolbar total height 112px; keep all ids, data-cmd values, aria labels, data-i18n attributes.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: only apps/web/apps/documenteditor-wysiwyg files; no id/data-cmd/design changes; no SVG replacement; do not run servers (no unit tests exist; the chrome pixel gate + geometry gate re-run after merge in the main checkout). Commit on the worktree branch with a conventional message.

Worktree layout: you are at the monorepo root; paths are relative to it. Read style.css around lines 595-615 and scan index.html for `<svg` in the #toolbar section before editing.
